reasons: Detention charges exceed the contract free time (2 hrs) and should be billed only for 1 hr ($60), but invoice bills $180 (overcharge $120).
Fuel surcharge calculated per contract (week of 2026‑09‑22 diesel $3.743) is $211.28, but invoice charges $213.78 (overcharge $2.50).
Total invoice ($1693.78) is $182.50 above the contract‑supported amount ($1511.28), exceeding the 1% tolerance.
decision.dispute_summary: Detention billed for 3 hours despite only 1 hour beyond the 2‑hour free allowance; fuel surcharge amount is higher than contract calculation.
